paragraphs: On Monday morning, Tom sat at his desk in class. He had a headache and a stomach-ache. He didn't eat any breakfast, and his legs were weak. He had a toothache last night, and his tooth was sore. Teacher Nick looked at him carefully. "What's the matter, Tom?" asked Teacher Nick. "I don't feel well," said Tom. "My head hurts, and my stomach hurts." "You look sick," said Teacher Nick. "Come with me to the nurse."

The nurse's room was small and quiet. Tom sat on a chair, and the nurse took his temperature. "It is OK," she said. "Did you eat breakfast today?" "No, I didn't," said Tom. "I got up late." The nurse smiled and gave him some water and a small cake. Tom had to sit and drink slowly. "You are weak because you didn't eat," she said. She gave Tom some medicine for his headache. The medicine didn't help his stomach, but the cake did. "Don't worry, Tom," said the nurse. "Rest here, please."

Mom came to school and took Tom home. Pip waited at the door and said, "Woof!" Tom sat on the sofa all afternoon. Lily drew a card for him. It said, "Get well, Tom!" Tom smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily." At dinner, Tom was well again. He ate a big bowl of rice. "Is your stomach OK now?" asked Mom. "Yes, it is," said Tom. "On Tuesday, I want a big breakfast."
text.summary: Tom feels sick at school on Monday. The nurse finds the reason, Mom takes him home, and Lily makes him a card.
